description: The same rush team on both sides of a 6-row gap: the battle stays symmetric.
A rush (two barracks) against a base with only a wall and its Core; soldiers walk across and destroy the Core.
A Core walled in on all sides (one weak wall, tier 1): the soldiers break through the weakest wall and reach the Core.
Three raiders (placed at tick 0) hunt the infrastructure of a base: its extractor and splitter fall, the splitter's conduits go with it and the barracks downstream starve.

Three powered tier 2 turrets beside the front edge kill three soldiers that cross it after a long walk across a 12-row gap, by which time the turrets are charged (they fire only once a unit stands on their own board rows).
The same three turrets without any supply never fire; the soldiers walk in and attack the Core.

A wall line with one gate: a soldier inside walks out through the gate (standing on its cell) while an enemy soldier outside cannot enter and attacks the gate, until the owning soldier comes out and kills it.
Eight tier 1 turrets; a lake band and walls leave a single approach (x = 8) right above them, so a twelve-soldier wave runs the gauntlet.
